description_en: Creates or updates the table-level configuration of a data validation task to specify the tables to validate, the validation scope, and the comparison rules
description_zh: 新建或更新数据校验任务的表明细配置，用于设定待校验表清单、校验范围与比对规则
kebab_example: aliyun lhm add-data-check-config --is-full-table-count 0 --source-columns col_a,col_b --source-group-clause col_a,col_b --source-hint /0+_READ_CONSISTENCY_WEAK_0/ --source-partition ds=20260116 --source-table table_demo --source-where-clause col_a_0_and_col_b_=_x --target-columns col_a,col_b --target-group-clause col_a,col_b --target-hint /0+_READ_CONSISTENCY_WEAK_0/ --target-partition ds=20260116 --target-table table_demo --target-where-clause col_a_0_and_col_b_=_x --task-config-info lhm_lhm_dw_0 --task-id 10001 --total-count-threshold 0.5 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataCheckConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform full-table validation. Valid values:

0: partition-level comparison.
1: full-table comparison
parameters.help_zh: 是否整表校验：0-分区为单位 1-整表
parameters.name: is_full_table_count

parameters.help_en: The columns of the source table. You can specify multiple columns separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 源表字段,可以填写多个字段用,分隔
parameters.name: source_columns

parameters.help_en: The GROUP condition of the source table
parameters.name: source_group_clause

parameters.help_en: The partition of the source table
parameters.name: source_partition

parameters.help_en: The name of the source table
parameters.name: source_table

parameters.help_en: The WHERE condition of the source table
parameters.name: source_where_clause

parameters.help_en: The columns of the target table. You can specify multiple columns separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 目标表字段,可以填写多个字段用,分隔
parameters.name: target_columns

parameters.help_en: The GROUP condition of the target table
parameters.name: target_group_clause

parameters.help_en: The partition of the target table
parameters.name: target_partition

parameters.help_en: The name of the target table
parameters.name: target_table

parameters.help_en: The WHERE condition of the target table
parameters.name: target_where_clause

parameters.help_en:
The batch table configurations for same-pattern creation (`taskMode=1`). Separate multiple configurations with a line break (`
`)
parameters.help_zh: 同模式批量创建（taskMode=1时），多条用\n分割
parameters.name: task_config_info

parameters.help_en: The ID of the validation task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The total data volume comparison threshold
parameters.name: total_count_threshold

data.description_en: The ID of the table-level configuration saved in this operation. You can use this ID to query or delete the configuration later
data.description_zh: 本次保存的待校验表明细配置 ID，可用于后续查询或删除该配置

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues with this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: successful.
false: failed. Check errCode and errMessage for the cause
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
